persistence: One MiniSat object and assumption-independent learned clauses per source
One native HiGHS model with retained weight-independent core rows
Direct changeColsCost; explicit previous hitting-set MIP start
Source-bound checked witnesses and branching proofs can survive processes
excluded_claims: No claim of HiGHS branch-and-bound tree retention across weight changes
No proof export from native MiniSat/HiGHS enters the checked lower bank
No equivalence to optimized iMaxHS or commercial MaxHS implementation
Native solver state is resident only, not serializable by this adapter

design: Shared known future request suffix; exact worst-outcome audit deficit forecasts. All controls have identical compact admission, compiled support class, native reuse, proof bridge and spending caps. Policies choose which computations to buy.
pricing: Operation tariffs, external audit count and native timing remain separate. No outcome probabilities, calibrated runtime price or total-cost superiority are assumed.
accounting_limits: Named operation tariffs account modelled primitive work; JSON serialization and memory allocation are timed but not assigned an extra operation tariff. Source-manifest read/hash is common measured setup outside arm counters. Native memory is not measured.

diagnostic.scope: Post-controller exhaustive diagnostic on DEVELOPMENT fixture; no held-out validation or controller access.
